claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment such as: Inverter, panels, charge...
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows two solar panel modules in a frame; no brand/serial/inverter/charge controller is shown, and the seller’s words are not verifiable from the provided observations.

risks.risk: Unknown wattage/rating per panel (W) and whether the set is sized for your load; this strongly affects value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel label/sticker showing wattage (W), voltage/current (Vmp/Imp), and model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case for an unknown/possibly lower-wattage used set (no performance guarantee).

risks.risk: Condition risk: possible glass damage, micro-cracks, delamination, or frame corrosion not visible in the wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of each panel’s glass surface (corners and edges) and the frame/joints, plus a photo of the back/edges if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential cosmetic/structural wear (assume not new).

risks.risk: Electrical integrity risk: junction box/cables/connectors may be damaged or mismatched.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the junction box and all visible cables/connectors (including polarity markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed fully functional; treat as needing inspection/possible replacement of connectors/cables.

risks.risk: Missing system components: the frame may include only panels; inverter/charge controller/battery are not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the full package contents laid out (panels, frame, junction box, any controller/inverter/battery if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as panels-only set (no inverter/charge controller/battery included).

risks.risk: Age/usage and performance degradation (used/refurbished panels can have reduced output).
risks.proof: Any proof of purchase, warranty card, or label showing manufacturing date; plus a seller-provided test report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/refurbished with unknown remaining lifespan.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the panel label/sticker for each module (wattage W, model, serial, manufacturing date).
Send close-up photos of glass corners/edges and the frame for cracks/chips/corrosion/delamination.
Send a photo/clip of the junction box and all connectors/cables (showing condition and type).
Confirm what is included in the sale: panels only vs any inverter/charge controller/battery, and show everything in one laid-out photo.
If available, provide warranty/proof of purchase or any performance test (I-V curve or simple output test).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a set of two solar panel modules mounted side-by-side in a frame, which is enough to price at a worst-case used/unknown-spec level; key details like wattage, brand/model, and condition are not readable and will be handled via worst-case assumptions until proven.
